title: US August CPI Releases Today: Markets Price 73%+ Odds of Fed Rate Hike at September FOMC
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the August CPI at 8:30 AM ET today (Sept 11), the last inflation data the Fed sees before next week's FOMC decision. Thursday's hotter-than-expected PPI raised the odds of a rate hike above 73%; headline CPI is expected at +3.4% YoY and core at +2.4% YoY.
why: 美联储9月FOMC议息前最后关键数据；若CPI超预期触发加息，将压制成长股估值并推高波动率——持仓中Sell Put策略在加息+高波动环境下Delta风险上升，需评估行权价安全边际。

title: Brent Crude Tops $101/bbl as US-Iran War Escalates at Strait of Hormuz; Iran Vows 'More Intense' Conflict
summary: Brent crude held above $101.84 a barrel (up ~9% in five days) as the US struck Iranian oil tankers and Iran threatened a broader war in the Strait of Hormuz. The strait channels ~20% of global oil supply; the IEA has characterized the disruption as the largest in global oil market history.
why: 油价破百推高通胀预期，强化美联储加息立场；对持仓而言，海底捞、美团等餐饮类承受成本端双重压力（食材+配送能源成本上涨），消费类港股估值亦面临压制；期权隐含波动率上升，短期卖出期权需谨慎。

title: Houthi Militants Strike Saudi Aramco Facilities; US Retaliates by Hitting Iranian Oil Tankers — Brent Hits 6-Week High
summary: Iran-backed Houthi militants attacked Saudi Aramco energy facilities, prompting a temporary shutdown of some operations; the US military responded by striking three Iranian-linked oil tankers. Brent crude surged to a six-week high above $97 (subsequently surpassing $101 as conflict continued escalating into Sept 10).
why: 延续报道：沙特阿美设施遭袭是中东地缘升级的关键节点，9月10日Brent续升破$101仍在发酵；能源供应风险将持续推高通胀预期，与Fed政策不确定性形成双重宏观压力。

title: Global Risk-Off: Hang Seng Falls ~300pts, Wall Street 3-Day Decline, US 10-Year Treasury at 4.86% (Highest Since Nov 2023)
summary: Surging oil prices and mounting Fed rate-hike bets triggered a broad global selloff on September 10: the Hang Seng Index fell ~300 points to around 24,970; US 10-year Treasury yields climbed to 4.86%; and Wall Street stocks extended losses into a third consecutive session.
why: 港股和美股同步承压——组合中的港股持仓（腾讯、泡泡玛特、美团、老铺黄金）短期均面临估值收缩压力；美债利率快速上行亦直接抬升期权定价的无风险利率基础，Sell Put总体吸引力暂降，宜评估各标的margin要求。

title: Xi-Trump Washington Summit Confirmed for Sept 24; US-China Negotiate Tariff Cuts on $30B of Goods 'at an Early Date'
summary: US and Chinese negotiators are striving for reciprocal tariff reductions on $30 billion of 'nonsensitive' goods ahead of Xi Jinping's confirmed Washington visit on September 24—their third face-to-face this year. The tariff truce expires November 10; the US is simultaneously eyeing a new 7.5% overcapacity tariff on Chinese exports before the summit.
why: 中美峰会在即，若谈判顺利达成关税减让，将正面提振中概股、港股整体估值；阿里巴巴（淘天跨境/国际）、拼多多（Temu出海）受益最直接；同时需警惕美国7.5%产能税落地的负面冲击，尤其影响电动车、消费电子相关板块。

title: 腾讯9月8日回购23万股，自5月授权以来近乎每日回购，年度最大回购计划持续推进
summary: 据HKEX公告，腾讯控股（0700.HK）9月8日从市场回购约23万股；9月2日亦回购约22.9万股（耗资约1亿港元）。5月股东大会批准最多回购约9.12亿股（约10%股本）后，腾讯已几乎每个交易日持续执行回购，系公司有史以来规模最大的单年度回购计划。
why: 延续报道：腾讯每日持续回购约22–23万股，管理层用实际行动表达估值低估判断，为股价提供下行支撑；当前宏观风险偏好下行背景下，持续回购降低持仓的相对风险，Sell Put方向可维持，同时关注回购是否因市场大跌而加量。

title: Disney CFO at Goldman Sachs Communacopia (Sept 9): Streaming Hits 13% Operating Margins, Q3 DTC Income Doubled
summary: At the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9, Disney CFO Hugh Johnston highlighted streaming profitability: Disney+ reached 13% operating margins in Q3; direct-to-consumer operating income more than doubled to $712M YoY. Management guided for 12% underlying EPS growth this fiscal year and flagged a shift from cost-cutting to a revenue-growth story.
why: Disney流媒体盈利拐点明确，商业模式可持续性增强；对DIS持仓者，12%的EPS增速目标支持Covered Call上移行权价；流媒体广告层（如有）还可带来额外收入，需关注Q4订阅增长数据确认趋势。

title: SanDisk CEO at Goldman Sachs Communacopia (Sept 9): Data Centers Now >50% of NAND Market; FY2028 Supply Largely Locked In
summary: SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler told Goldman Sachs Communacopia attendees on Sept 9 that AI-driven data center demand has crossed 50% of total NAND market for the first time—a structural watershed. SanDisk has signed 8 long-term data center supply agreements in the past 9 months and locked ~2/3 of FY2028 bit supply. Management reiterated FY2028–2030 targets: mid-to-high teens revenue growth, ~80% gross margins, ~70% operating margins.
why: AI数据中心存储需求结构性验证，供应端确定性高（FY28约2/3供应已预售），高毛利目标（80%毛利率）业绩可见度强；SanDisk与美光（Micron）、SK海力士同处存储超级周期，适合维持Sell Put策略捕获期权收益。
